definitions.explanation: Technology that overlays digital information (images, sounds, text) onto the real-world environment, typically viewed through a smartphone or special glasses.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Abbreviation of English "Augmented Reality." Pronounced えーあーる in Japanese.

USAGE:
AR overlays digital information onto the real world, typically viewed through a smartphone camera or special glasses. Popularized in Japan through games like Pokemon GO.

COMMON APPLICATIONS:
- ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧: location-based and interactive games
- ⟦ショッピング→ショッピング：28815_shoppingu⟧: virtual try-on, furniture placement
- ナビゲーション: navigation and wayfinding
- ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧: educational overlays and interactive learning

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- AR⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧: AR application
- AR⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧: AR technology
- AR⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧: AR function/feature
- AR⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧: AR experience

SIMILAR WORDS:
- AR (⟦{拡張|かくちょう}{現実|げんじつ}→拡張現実：20485_kakuchougenjitsu⟧): digital overlay on the real world
- VR (⟦{仮想|かそう}{現実|げんじつ}→仮想現実：20409_kasougenjitsu⟧): fully immersive virtual environment
- MR (⟦{複合|ふくごう}→複合：14114_fukugou⟧⟦{現実|げんじつ}→現実：02720_genjitsu⟧): mixed reality, blending real and virtual

The full Japanese term ⟦{拡張|かくちょう}{現実|げんじつ}→拡張現実：20485_kakuchougenjitsu⟧ exists but the English abbreviation AR is far more common in everyday use.
